balls.text: another low full toss, cuffed hard to deep midwicket, hard running gets them back for the second, and a target of 198 is something to play with in RCB's must-win game
down the track again, clawed across the line for a lucky boundary! Shanaka went to ground early at deep midwicket to cut off the second run, but the greasy outfield took him straight past the ball!
low full toss, and picked up superbly over deep midwicket! If Kohli was a bit frustrated at losing the strike, that's cheered him up. Only the third six of the night... but a timely one!
a gallop to the pitch, met on the full, smacked across the line to deep midwicket. Kohli wants the second but Rawat says no

Steps across the full toss, and Miller sprawls brilliantly at long-on! Is it a clean take? He's not sure, so it's going upstairs. Nope, I think that's burst through his fingers, but it counts as a fine diving intercept all the same, flinging himself forward. But crucially, it also means Kohli is back on strike
full length, scooped to long-on! Back-to-back hundreds! There are not enough superlatives. On his watch, RCB are staying alive in the IPL!
Kohli pulls out the dive as the direct hit comes in! But he's safely home! The shy was flat from long-off, but he wanted the strike... and gets it!
dipping on the toes, clipped hard to deep midwicket... he wants the second, he settles for one! Timed that one too well, and the Chinnaswamy has to bide its time
back of a length, leg-sided again, slower ball, poor ball... put away! Kohli swings across his stroke and finds acres of space behind square... to move to 98
yorker, outside off, Rawat stabs his stroke into the off side and scampers the single to get Kohli back on strike
fuller length, attacking middle and leg, solid contact from Kohli as he takes the single to mid-on
low full toss, that's free runs for Kohli! Swinging into the pads, his eye is so far in it's protruding out of the far side of the ball as it gets smoked off the toes through square leg!
fuller length, slower ball, comfortable clip to deep midwicket to keep the strike and keeping RCB marching towards 200
over-pitched on the legs, and Kohli's clip is sweet as a peach! There's a man lurking at short backward square, but he hasn't a prayer of getting involved there as the ball hurtles to the rope!
bottom-handed thump, out of the full length, sweetly timed but straight towards Miller at long-on
flinched out of the arm-pit, to square leg
blatted into the stands! Such bat-speed! It was a reasonably full length, but just wide enough to free the arms, with a brutal swipe, hard and flat over deep midwicket
outside off, cuffed to deep point and Kohli is only interested in the single. It's all on him tonight...
tight lines, speed through the air, jammed into the off side. Rashid is seen off, and now it's about how RCB can finish
slammed out through deep midwicket, got that low on the bat as Rashid skidded another wicket-to-wicket delivery through at the stumps. A fine slide in the deep to save four
down on one knee, trying to impart some force on the slog-sweep but can't connect fully. Deep square gathers on the bounce
back of a length, skidding into the pads, flicked behind square
on the back foot, whipped to the on-side, deep in the crease
tight line as ever, met with an open face, steered to the off side
fired in full, flicked off the toes to the on-side
stunning timing! Full-length, outside off, Kohli waited with an open face and just flipped it past backward point, timing like a perfectly executed flip of the paddle on a pinball machine
soft hands, tapped out to the off side, another single to the cause
open face on the wide yorker, fended out to backward point
back of a length, flogged through the covers! Kohli is smoking his strokes now, hasn't seen much of the strike of late but nailed that chance, wide of off stump
short, and swings into the pull to leg, can't connect properly
slow and wide, outside the off stump
nurdled off the toes to the leg side.
slower ball, back of a length, Rawat waits on the back foot and taps the single to backward point
very full, and angled bat on the front foot into the covers
half forward, on the front foot, pushed into the covers

bouncer, down the leg side, and flicks the glove through to the keeper! DK's gone first-ball! Anything more on that and it was probably four, but the extra bounce got too big on him as he swished across the line! Whatever was said in the Time-Out, it seems not to have worked for RCB...
on the front foot, and driven into the off side
huge top-edge on the full toss! A big swing across the line, Bracewell can't connect properly, a steepling chance for the bowler to claim himself. The end of a handy knock
on the back foot, soft hands on the poke to backward point
low full toss, swinging away, attempted sweep from Bracewell thumps the pad, but that was doing too much to hit the off stump. And looked like an inside-edge too
flipped off the toes, out to the leg-side, the lack of power allows them to rush back for the second
yorker, excellently bowled, Bracewell digs it out but straight back at the bowler
blazing drive, open face on the front foot, straight to the cover sweeper
low full toss, clipped to long-on, closing the face on impact
another slower ball, maybe third time lucky? Nope, whacked with sufficient timing into the leg side. Bracewell is putting together a priceless knock here
slow bouncer, but Bracewell is wise to the pace-off now, waits for it to arrive this time, and mashes it through midwicket, off the eyebrows!

so nearly holes out to point! Extraordinary passage of play. Such a slow slower ball, out of the back of the hand, Bracewell was committed to the full-blooded swing, slammed on the brakes and ended up fencing a looping chance through the gap between point and gully
back of a length, tight to off stump, opens the face for a steer to short third
sits up, back of a length, and slammed in front of the cover sweeper! On the front foot, in every sense. Kohli is feeling it tonight
flicked out to the leg side to pick off another single. Steady progress in that over for RCB
flashed off the back foot, out to deep cover, there's the fifty for the in-form Kohli. From 35 balls with more to come, you sense
skids into the hip, a missed flick and that should have been a leg-bye but Bracewell said no
wide line, Kohli under-edges his cut to stay on 49
worked to the on-side on a fuller length
crashed to the rope once more! Down on one knee, clubbed up and into the stroke, through the covers. A handy cameo building now
full and into the toes, nudged to the on-side
inside-out, up and over long-off! Picks his spot to perfection, no coverage out there. Didn't nail the timing, but the intent did enough
slapped through the gap in the covers! Stays leg-side, with a strong base, and just flings the bat through the width. Nailed it
bouncer, a late call of wide as the ball gets big past the eyebrows. Really not a lot wrong with that! Bracewell missed edging his pull by a whisker
very full, wide of off stump, Bracewell drives but doesn't make contact outside his eyeline
a skip to the pitch, can't connect on a thrash into the covers
punched at the top of the bounce, on the front foot, into the covers once more
nurdled off the legs to keep the strike. Virat is still in the zone, even if his team-mates are being knocked out of it
onto the front foot, inside-edged on the drive to midwicket
flipped off the toes to backward square
slapped with power through long-off! A stride to the pitch, and puts away the full length with aplomb!
turning into the pads of the new left-hander, worked to the on-side
dragged out of the crease, and Saha whips off the bails! Lomror went for a gallop, Noor fired it past the pads at pace, that's an excellent pick-up and take-down. RCB are faltering now!
looped up onto the pads, flicked behind square
very full, but down the leg side
cracked out to deep point, on the back foot. An exceptional over from Rashid, whose figures are starting to look game-changing
onto the front foot, angled defence to the on-side
back of a length, attempted chop through point but beaten by the overspin, outside off
gets in a tangle first-up, struck on the pads but no thoughts of a review

Skids through a loose back-foot drive! Massive wicket for Rashid! Maxwell was looking to be forceful but that just deviated a fraction, wicket to wicket with a touch of turn back into the bat. His shot finds thin air as the ball finds the top of middle!
lumped through the full length, not timed as the drive bobbles to long-off
another big wind-up, deflects off the pads towards gully
more width, more power! Lovely balance as he picks the googly and thumps his hands through the width, through extra cover
donked into the stands! Very full length from Noor, but outside the line of off, and so right in Maxwell's arc. A full swing of the bat and lots of bottom hand, high over long-on!
looped up on the fuller length, open-faced push to deep cover
over the wicket, tight line on the pads, hard-handed push to the on-side

huge appeal for the catch at slip! And Faf knows he's edged that. A wild swipe, and it looked as though it cannoned off the bottom of his bat, past the off stump, into the keeper's right knee and up into the hands of Tewatia. The Chinnaswamy is silenced!
back of a length, angled in on the leg stump, fenced to the on-side. A tidy over to launch the post-powerplay period
back of a length, skids into a flat pull, wide long-on intercepts on the boundary's edge
more turn from a full length, back into the pads, worked to square leg
driven with an open face, on the full length, out to extra cover
full length, turning into the pads, Faf is forward and nudges the single to leg
tapped into the off side
flicked firmly off the legs, out to deep midwicket to put a dent in Noor's first over. That's time for the Time Out, with RCB doing all they can to muscle into the play-off party
skids through too full, and guided to the rope! Just enough width for Kohli to open the face outside off and pick off the boundary
nurdled off the legs to the on-side. Some control now for GT
awkward leading edge! Stopped in the pitch as Kohli lobbed it off the back foot, and just eluded the men in the covers. A dolly if it had carried
skimming through the crease, leg-stump line, cramping the pads
makes room to leg, Noor follows him from over the wicket, a measured flick to the leg side
very full, Faf is back on his stumps to flick to the leg side
drags a slogged drive out to the leg side, in the air for a time but safely through the vacant midwicket
slides onto the back foot, punched with a full face to mid-off
on the legs, and yanked through the leg side
onto the front foot, opens the face and skews a drive through point
skids on, too wide, Virat hacks off the back foot with commanding power, clean through point!
Width, too full, too easy to give that the launch! Swinging away, Faf unleashes his forearms and pummels it high through wide long-off. This is a four-fest!
flashed through the line, on the front foot, and straight into Kohli's shin! That was four all the way, but Faf gets robbed by his partner!
back of a length but into the body this time, Kohli fends in the air for a time, Yash rushes through and Faf is nearly in trouble as the flick comes in at the striker's end
more power in the cross-batted wallop! Kohli too has the measure of this deck. Anything on the shorter side of a length is getting the treatment now!
too short, sits up, spanked across the line! High and mighty, two bounces to the rope
steps into the stroke, and pinged up and over the leg side! Kohli joins the party, that was in his arc, inviting the bottom hand to get busy!

sits back and wiped over mid-on! He's sized up the bounce in this wicket nice and early, camped on the back foot to hit up into his strokes. The fielder got pretty close to that in the ring, but enough power and elevation to get to the rope
flogged off the full length, out to deep square leg, Faf inspects the bottom of his bat as he turns down the single
three in a row! Not remotely timed this time, but the under-edged pull gives fine leg too much ground to cover. A sprawling dive is in vain, as his hand is touching the rope on impact
hits the pitch, hoicked through midwicket! More composed strike, with a solid base, launching up and across the length delivery, through the gap effectively
flighty swipe, but effective! Sits up just back of a length, a wild hack as Faf has a charge, and skewed high over the cover ring!
cramped on the angle into the pads, half-forward to squeeze the pushed defence back to the bowler
hoisted across the line, lots of excitement at the intent in the stroke, but backward square limits the damage. Tidy introduction for Yash
attempted punch through the line, not quite to the pitch of the ball as they pick off a single to no-man's land behind the bowler. Mid-off sweeps up
soft hands, angled bat on the back foot, tapped down to deep third
crashed with intent but no timing, straight to short cover off the inside-edge of the blade
chases the width from back of a length, down the track but can't reach the outswinger with a loose drive. Through to the keeper
over the wicket, tight line outside off, firm hands on the push to cover
rising into the pads, and fenced out to the leg-side
fuller length, on off stump, open face again from Kohli as he picks off the single to short third
tighter line, back of a length, jammed into the covers off the back foot
thrashed to the cover boundary! Imperious from Kohli, a fraction of width and he seizes upon it with high hands and an open face
swinging past the legs, movement on show, but on the wrong line
back of a length, shaping away with extra lift off the deck. Firm hands from Kohli on an open-faced drive, straight at point
very full, attacking the pads, patted back down the track with a full face. 136kph first-up from Shami

Hundred for Gill! Two centuries in a row, as RCB are eliminated. That means MI make the playoffs. A pin-drop silence at the ground, as the Bangalore crowd sees its side miss out on the playoffs. It was a length ball on the stumps from Parnell, as Gill heaved down the pitch to just beat long-on to his right to grab six and ensure GT enter the playoffs with good momentum

wide yorker outside off, as he tries to slice but is beaten. Gill was across off there, but it's called wide. Now it's RCB's turn to review. The ball landed beyond the permitted line, so it stays wide

wow, that's a high full toss which is dipping to end very wide of off. Called wide, even as Gill reviews for a potential above-waist no-ball. Ah, it's called no-ball for height, as the ball would have been close to his chest had it been on the stumps
skips out, and Harshal follows. Bowls full and wide of off, as Tewatia lets it go
length ball outside off, and tucked back to the bowler
slower ball. Full outside off, and driven between long-off and deep point
short outside off, and pulled to deep square
This should be it for RCB! Full toss gifted by Harshal at just the ideal height, as the ball angled into him while finishing around middle stump. Swung over for six
very full, and heading into the batter. Ends outside leg, and called wide after Gill tried to flick
full and slower ball on his pads. Flicked to fine leg

Gill keeps MI alive! A flat six over deep square leg. Siraj went on the shorter side of a length around off, and Gill expertly swung his bat for a hard hit that travelled rapidly to stun the Chinnaswamy crowd
good length and wide of off. Left alone, and called wide
good length ball straightening towards off. Guided to deep third

sliced to deep point! RCB keep striking. Prabhudessai, stationed right at the edge of the rope, holds it reverse cupped over his face. Miller's stay was short, and he didn't get going at all. This ball was quite full - following on from a good length ball - and wide of off, while also shaping away. Miller opened the bat face and lofted, only to find the fielder on the rope
goes flashing but is beaten. Good length ball angling across and ending wide-ish of off, but Miller can't capitalise
good length outside off, and swat-pulled to long-on
swung over deep midwicket! A short-arm pull, and the ball flies for six. Length delivery from Siraj on off - okay, that wasn't all that full - but Gill used his bottom hand to slam that away
change of pace. Shortish outside off, and half-pulled towards long-on while playing aerially
good length outside off, and now finds the gap between deep backward square and deep midwicket while pulling at that. Siraj from deep square cleans it to his left

slower ball on a good length outside off. Pulled between long-on and deep midwicket, before Maxwell - at long-on - rushes to his right, and pats the ball back with his outstretched right hand. Saved two there
good length outside off, and driven to long-off
wide given, although seemed tight. Full and angling across to end outside off, as Miller missed his slash
short outside off, and swatted to long-off
full and wide of off, and heaved off the inside half of the bat to long-on
good ball, but a fumble by the keeper allows a bye. Slower bouncer, which is angling across to end around off stump. Miller let it go, but they got a run eventually
very full on off, and driven down. Du Plessis dived to his left from extra cover to stop that
pulled to short fine's right! Shortish on leg stump, as he swivelled to pull past the fielder and get off the mark with a four

Harshal strikes! Shanaka finds deep midwicket too. Change of pace from Harshal, who went fullish and outside off. Shanaka seemed to be beaten by the lack of pace, and hoicked across the line. But the ball took off from what seemed like very close to the inside edge, and kept flying towards deep midwicket. Simple catch for sub fielder Prabhudessai
off the bottom edge to the keeper, as he looked to slash at this good length ball outside off
slower ball on a good length outside off. Hacked to deep point
shortish and wide of off. Left alone, and called wide
keeps low off a good length on off, as he stabs towards point with an open face of the bat

now taken at deep midwicket! Kohli there had to go low to his right while grabbing that. It was on the shorter side of a length around middle, as Shankar looked to keep smashing and clearing the boundary. But this seemed to have come off the inside half of the bat, and flew to the fielder
hits the roof! That is also Shankar's fifty. That was a huge six, as he stood after clearing the front leg, and hoicked the length ball across the line to keep raking up runs this over
clean strike down the pitch! Shankar making up for lost time. Length ball on the stumps, and Shankar stands with his front leg out of the way to launch that back
ramped over the leaping keeper! A slower bouncer from Vyshak, as Shankar sees that rising nicely over middle stump, and plays that really, really late to send it away right behind the wicket
hit on the back thigh, as this good length ball keeps low while angling into leg. Shankar looks to swipe but misses, as the ball rolls away to the off side
pulled to fine leg, as the ball is short around middle and off
four more... with an outside edge! Yorker length ball from Siraj on off, as Shankar manages to squeeze that out while trying to opening the bat face. The ball races away past the keeper
change of pace. Shortish outside off, and pulled wide of long-on
swats this good length ball around off, but only manages to dribble to long-off
length ball on off, and clipped to fine leg
good length ball on off, and pulled to deep square
That made a pleasing sound! This went even higher while flying over deep midwicket. He was deep in the crease at this length ball around middle and off, as he had a big heave across the line
again gets beaten on the attempted reverse sweep to this ball outside off
that flies over long leg! That was full and near his pads, as he went low and half-swept-half-heaved at that for a big six
tries to reverse sweep this full and wide-ish ball outside off, but is beaten
two more for Gill. Fuller and wide of off, and a misfield by the point fielder getting across in front of short third allows another run
good length on off, and swept to deep square for a hurried two
pulled to deep midwicket aerially. Short again outside off, and he gets on top of the bounce to swipe that
short ball outside off, and swatted to extra cover after almost being cramped for room
ah, loses his top hand there. Looked like he swung too hard at this length ball outside off, which he managed to flay to deep backward point
high full toss angling into leg, but he can only clip wide of short fine leg
another yorker length ball outside off, which Gill jams back down the ground. Another fifty for Gill this season
slower ball on a yorker length on off. Clipped to deep midwicket, and they pinch two. Great running
full around off, and drilled to long-off
wide of long-off!! Dances down at this full ball outside off, which turns away, but Gill crashes this through the gap
loopy and very full on off. Driven to deep point
slog swept between long-on and deep midwicket! Full and straight ball, and a late swing of the bat from Shankar
good length outside off. Hints to turn away, and is poked towards point
slices this full ball outside off to deep extra cover
slower bouncer, as he digs it on middle and off, and has Gill ducking
slower ball, and full on off. Pushed to long-on
and the new bat gets him four right away! Guides this good length ball on fifth stump, and places to the point fielder's right
short-arm punch at this good length ball on the stumps to extra cover's left
sower ball on a good length on off, and punched to extra cover
starts with a yorker length ball outside off, which Gill jams back off his pad to the off side
short and outside off. Hacked to deep point with the turn away from him
now that's a clean whip! Length ball heading down middle and leg, as he cleared his front leg and walloped that over deep midwicket
More luck for GT! Jumps out and hoicks across the line at this full ball on middle, which is turning away. But gets an outside edge towards the deep third boundary
length ball heading down leg. Takes his pads towards short fine, as he looks to flick

appeal for stumping, but the square-leg umpire doesn't look interested. Eventually, he does take it the third umpire. Short outside off, as Shankar chopped it back to the keeper on the bounce. Rawat then whipped the bails off, and appealed for stumping. But Shankar's right foot was well inside, even as he seemed to swivel. So it is not out
low full toss on leg, and clipped to deep square
change of pace again. This is short outside off, and swat-pulled to long-on
belted over the bowler's head! He waited for the slower ball to arrive on a length outside off, and had a clean swing of the bat while launching into it
change of pace, and Shankar mistimes his loft wide of deep third. It was full and outside off, as Shankar swung his bat without any timing. Surprised that they took only one
short ball angling into leg. Pulled to long leg after backing away, as the fielder there tumbles to his right to cut that off
too high, and wide called. Banged in short on middle, and heading down the leg side as Shankar only has to half-duck
short of a length just outside off, and tapped to point after riding the bounce
quite full on middle, and whipped to deep midwicket
fuller on middle, and pushed to extra cover
good length on off, and swept to deep square
short outside off, and pulled to deep midwicket
beats the batter, the stumps and the keeper. Good length ball on middle, and quicker too. Shankar pulled but missed, an the ball went on top of the stumps as Rawat also missed
pulls aerially to deep midwicket, as he gets a good length ball on the stumps
turns away a shortish ball, as it ends outside off. Swiped to long-on
backs away, and drives this full ball around leg stump to extra cover
dabs this shortish ball outside off wide of point for a single
another outside edge goes for four! Luck on GT's side. Good length just outside off, as Shankar drove forward, even as the ball went past the diving keeper to his right

Shankar gets going! Lofted over mid-on even with hardly any foot movement to get to the pitch of the ball. It was a length ball all right though, which arrived on the stumps, as he went high with the full face of the bat
short of a length, and wide-ish of off. Slapped to mid-off's right, even as the fielder dives to save three
wide of the short-third fielder! Length ball angling across, as Gill throws his bat at it and gets an outside edge which flies away from the fielder
another dot for Shankar, as he pokes at this shortish ball around off to point. And again he is sent back by Gill
a short-arm pull at this good length ball outside off to deep midwicket
punched aerially to deep backward point, as it is a shortish ball outside off
short of a length, angling in to end on off. Dabbed back to the bowler
short outside off, and pulled to deep square
starts with a slower ball, which is swatted back between the bowler and mid-off. It was short and wide of off, as Shankar slapped it down
short of a length just outside off, and tapped to short third. He is sent back by Gill after an attempted run
punches this shortish ball outside off to cover point
outside edge, but four! Shankar even lost his bottom hand, as he pushed at this fullish ball angling across the batter, and ending around fifth stump. The ball goes wide of the keeper
nudges this good length ball finishing outside off after angling away, and again finds the extra-cover fielder
good length, angling across to end on fourth stump. Punched towards extra cover
full and outside off. Driven wide of mid-off for a single

excellent catch at extra cover! Parnell leaps - and does so just at the right time - with his left hand sticking upwards. The ball arrives right there, and Saha's struggle ends. Some justice for Siraj in the end after an eventful over so far. Saha looked to slice this length ball outside off, as he skipped out again and even got the elevation, but that just wasn't enough

inside edge for four! Saha not really in control tonight, but he's still managing the runs. Length ball just outside off, as he jumps out and heaves across the line. But the ball goes past the stumps, and away for four to fine leg

Siraj is busy appealing for leg before, and the ball dribbles away to deep third's left. But hang on, RCB review the original not-out decision. The ball is on a good length, and around fifth stump. It angles back in sharply while also bouncing nicely off the pitch. Saha looks to pull but misses, and his hit high on his back thigh. There's no bat involved, and looked like that was too high while also heading down leg. Yup, that was going over middle and leg
punched aerially over cover. This was short of a good length, and again outside off. But now he rode the bounce, albeit he played that in the air to deep point
another dot for Saha. Punches at this good length ball outside off, but finds the point fielder
good length on fifth stump, and tapped to point
lovely loft over mid-on! He holds the pose too. Length ball this time, and on the stumps. He slightly closes the bat face, and sends that flaying over the in field
pulled away to fine leg! Short of a length on leg stump, as he swings his bat full circle to dispatch that wide and over the short-fine fielder
good length just outside off, as he dabs it down with the closed face of the bat
good length on leg, and clipped to deep square
skips out, and gets lucky runs over short third! He made room and swung across the line, as the ball was on a length and angling away to end wide-ish of off
looked like this good length ball on middle and leg kept a little low, as Saha had to adjust before pushing it towards extra cover
yorker length on sixth stump. Dug out towards mid-off
leading edge just over point! Closed the bat face at this good length ball on the stumps, but did that early. The ball barely ballooned over the fielder
and once again! This time he goes slashing with a flat bat at this short and wide ball outside off, but again gets beaten
beaten outside off again. Goes pushing at this shortish ball around sixth stump, but still can't get it away
stabs this good length ball which is wide of off to the man at point
outside edge, but short of the slip fielder. This was a length ball in the channel, as Saha pushed and got an outside edge
goes flashing at this short and wide ball outside off, which angles away further. He is beaten, and it's given wide
